review: Fresh independent original2017 source/coverage and question/key scope challenge

source_key_correctness.finding: No false original2017 factual answer or excluded-effect scenario found in the 67 fixed entries. Factual truth does not imply every bundled statement is actually asked.

scope_mapping.finding: Four required-fact bundles contain true but unasked extensions; Q58 misses an explicitly asked phase-sequence step.

coverage_stopping_challenge.finding: Accepted-compensation branch is absent, and source-first audit also finds unasked setup, ordinary public sharing and turn-advancement/victory procedures. Theft color independence is present only as an unasked required assertion. Reset the zero-addition count after concrete expansion.

independence.note: File-name discovery initially enumerated some sibling QA filenames; their contents were not opened. Source metadata and accepted component originals only outside the five allowed QA inputs.

method.scope: Original2017 base all9 species and all8 named Faderan reverse procedures; authoritative designer direct2017 clarifications only. No module behavior, Remastered, expansions, house rules or other-user forum commentary used.
method.novelty_standard: New rule, rule-defined outcome branch, or consequential timing/priority/exception. Reject changed amounts, cosmetic names and mechanical recombinations.
method.coverage_standard: Only actual asked clauses earn coverage; true key context and source-group labels do not. No global source-gap caps and no reader grading.
method.card_quantities: No all-card recall quota. Exact ordinary printed outputs remain physical-card reads; requested specific quantities still required.
method.scope_analysis: Every required fact compared with its question; required/context identity across asked-facts and fixed key machine-checked; all67 question texts agree.
method.author_lineage: API author1220373 matches TauCetiDD/TauCeti Deichmann profile and2017 booklet credit. Complete designer bodies match derivatives exactly; total raw article counts6 and5 equal included counts. Other authors and quoted material excluded from independent authority.
method.crop_lineage: All13 accepted native crops reproduced from immutable hash-matching parents with exact pixels, original bounds and rotations. Printed layout/remaining phase content agrees with2017 booklet diagrams.

actionable_new_coverage.proposed_question: An agreed future delivery becomes impossible. May the player offer substitute compensation instead, whose agreement is required, and do the fixed nonfulfillment penalties automatically apply if everyone involved agrees to and receives that compensation?

The rejected-compensation partial-fulfillment/penalty procedure is conditional on failing to agree; it does not automatically apply on top of accepted substitute compensation.
required_new_facts: Compensation may substitute for impossible promised performance.
Everyone involved must agree, including all wronged parties.
Accepted and delivered substitute resolves the compensation branch; fixed penalty branch is for disagreement.
actionable_new_coverage.source: Booklet p6 Trade Phase, entire impossible-promise paragraph; extraction zero-based contiguous character range [10545,11151).
actionable_new_coverage.why_not_covered: Both explicitly assume rejected compensation and ask the failure penalty. Neither asks whether accepted compensation can substitute or who must assent. A scenario premise that compensation was rejected earns no accepted-outcome coverage.
actionable_new_coverage.novelty: A different source-defined result, not changed goods/numbers or a mechanical recombination.

actionable_new_coverage.proposed_question: During player setup, where does each species get its starting resource quantities and starting number of ships? Are these taken from the species card or generated by running all starting economic converters first?
actionable_new_coverage.expected_answer: Collect the starting resources and number of ships printed on the species card during setup; the game begins with Trade, so setup is not an extra Economy.
required_new_facts: Starting resource quantities and ship count are collected as printed on the species card.
actionable_new_coverage.source: Booklet p3 Player Setup, sentence immediately above starred-card procedure; p4 first Trade.
actionable_new_coverage.why_not_covered: Q21 asks star/library and dealt colony/research handling; Q22 tracks and visible tile information; Q23 visibility/unlimited pieces. None asks where starting resources or ship counts come from. No particular species quantity is demanded.
actionable_new_coverage.novelty: Setup allocation procedure, no all-card memorization quota.

actionable_new_coverage.proposed_question: In an ordinary non-Yengii Confluence, what must each inventor announce and do with the technology cards they invented during Trade, and how should the cards be arranged so other players can identify the shared inventions?
actionable_new_coverage.expected_answer: Announce every invented technology and put those technology cards face down in the middle, splayed so their names are readable. Other players find their own matching cards.
required_new_facts: Announce every technology invented that Trade.
Place invented technology cards face down in the center with readable splayed names.
actionable_new_coverage.source: Booklet p8 Confluence Phase, second paragraph; p9 diagram shows shared technology splay.
actionable_new_coverage.why_not_covered: Q04 asks how to invent from a controlled research team plus entry/bonus timing, not physical sharing announcement/splay. Its expected answer mentions this handling, but required facts do not. Q48 explicitly asks the exceptional Yengii placement, not ordinary placement. Q66 asks timing/awards/order.
actionable_new_coverage.novelty: A new public-card handling rule; ordinary public record versus Yengii private-to-player splay is consequential for identifying inventions.

actionable_new_coverage.proposed_question: At the end of an ordinary turn, what happens to the current Confluence Technology Sharing Bonus card and what information is on its back? When another ordinary turn remains, which phase starts next? After final scoring, what do players reveal and how is the winner determined?
actionable_new_coverage.expected_answer: Flip the current Confluence card upside down and add it to the shared-technology splay; its back lists the remaining phases. Continue to the next Trade when an ordinary next turn remains, interpreting final Turn6 using the printed counter and designer clarification rather than adding a seventh Trade. At game end reveal hidden points; highest total victory points wins (ties have no tiebreaker).
required_new_facts: Current Confluence bonus card is flipped upside down and added to shared-technology splay.
Reveal hidden points; highest victory point total wins.
actionable_new_coverage.source: Booklet p9 Ending the Turn and Ending the Game; printed original remaining-phase backs; designer26690049 resolves final-round wording.
actionable_new_coverage.why_not_covered: Q03 covers returned loans; Q58 counts phases and final sequence, not advancement-card operation. Q10/Q55 calculate scores and ties, but never ask the reveal/highest-total winner rule. These are separate unasked core passages.
actionable_new_coverage.novelty: New progression/card-state rule and victory outcome; not another numerical scoring example. May be split into two questions for clarity.
